children: rose 9.15% premarket after raising prices on its on-demand compute from October 1, according to a customer communication reshared on Reddit and X. IREN Ltd.
Under the new rates, H100 hourly rates go to $4.50 from $3.85, an increase near 17%. H200 rises 20% to $5.40, B200 almost 19% to $8.50, and Nvidia's
B300 about 21% to $9.50 from $7.85. For CPU, AMD
EPYC Genoa will increase 25% to $0.015 per vCPU-hour and Genoa memory up roughly 41% to $0.0045 per GiB-hour. The impact on any given customer's bill depends on their configuration and usage.

Nebius secured about $775 million in debt financing in July backed by deployed GPU infrastructure and contracted customer cash flows. Second-quarter revenue rose 454% to $582.3 million, with AI Cloud revenue up 514% to $574.9 million, and adjusted EBITDA swung to a $236.2 million profit from a $21 million loss. The company reaffirmed 2026 revenue guidance of $3 billion to $3.4 billion and expects ARR of $7 billion to $9 billion by year end.

title: Nebius Stock Jumps 9% After Raising GPU Rates
